name: Sam Ortiz
profile: Sam (they/them) managed a retail store for six years and is moving into customer success roles. They still work full-time at the store during the search.

facts.text: Calmed a customer whose wedding order was lost by finding a replacement within two hours, and the customer left happy
Saved a customer's lost wedding order with a replacement found in two hours, and the customer became a regular who later wrote a five-star review
Wrote an onboarding checklist that cut new-hire ramp time at the store from six weeks to three
Raised the store's customer satisfaction score from 72 to 89 in one quarter, up from the lowest in the district
Ran a loyalty program push that signed up 400 customers in one month
Pellwick final round booked for Monday October 12
Pellwick moved the final round to Wednesday October 14
Vantlow Software rejected them after the second interview
Vantlow Software reached back out about a customer success associate role
Wants a referral at Orchardly, where their neighbor Joanne works
Their stories are strong, but their answers to why this company are generic
Says we so often that their own part in a story gets lost
Tired from working full-time at the store during the search
Worried that retail experience won't count for customer success roles

sessions.outline: First session. Sam explains they are moving from retail management to customer success while still working full-time, and they are tired. They tell the lost wedding order story, which ends with the customer leaving happy.
Mock customer success screen. Sam tells the onboarding checklist story well, but their answer to why this company is generic. Wren debriefs.
Vantlow Software rejected them after the second interview. Sam worries retail experience won't count.
Mock with a hiring-manager persona. Sam tells the satisfaction turnaround story but talks fast, and Wren points it out.
Logistics: Pellwick booked Sam's final round.
Mock for Pellwick. Sam tells the loyalty program story, and Wren notices they say we so much that their own part gets lost.
Pellwick moved the final round. Sam also retells the wedding order story with a new ending: the customer became a regular and wrote a review.
Surprise: Vantlow Software reached back out about a different role.
Wren nudges Sam toward a referral and they name their neighbor at Orchardly. They are still worn out from work.
Sam and Wren prep for the Pellwick final. Sam admits their answer to why Pellwick still feels thin and retells the onboarding story.
